status: Fixed before computing these CAMB spectra. Conditional construction with published Planck background and source calibration, not a blind OPH prediction.

baseline_validation.scope: Engineering validation against released raw best-fit theory; excludes cosmic variance and is not a data likelihood. Report all differences even if a threshold fails.

interpretation: 3D dimensionless primordial curvature power, scalar passive adiabatic initial conditions, standard flat LCDM transfer.
Histories prepare an initial field and cease to be an active stochastic source by the matching epoch.
Background, matter content, recombination, reionization, amplitude and calibrated tilt are imported.
Every case recomputes transfer and nonlinear lensing; no stale transfer reuse.
The retained unlensed spectra provide a linear-transfer diagnostic. HMcode2016 nonlinear lensing is approximate and not validated for the UV-cutoff source.
No physical parameter or source cutoff is optimized against these outputs.
